semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in vacuum pumps and services critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Infraserv Vakuumservice GmbH, a subsidiary of Shimadzu Corporation, provides specialized turbomolecular and fore-vacuum pumps for the semiconductor industry. The company offers maintenance, repair, and customized system solutions, collaborating with major brands to support semiconductor manufacturers and equipment builders across Europe.

regional_presence.Europe: Based in Eching near Munich, Infraserv serves as a key partner for semiconductor manufacturers and equipment builders across Europe.
